title: Deep End-to-End Survival Analysis with Temporal Consistency
abstract: arXiv:2410.06786v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this study, we present a novel Survival Analysis algorithm designed to efficiently handle large-scale longitudinal data. Our approach draws inspiration from Reinforcement Learning principles, particularly the Deep Q-Network paradigm, extending Temporal Learning concepts to Survival Regression. A central argument in our method relies on temporal consistency, a recursive consistency condition between survival predictions made at consecutive states. Our framework introduces a delayed target network that decouples the generation of temporally consistent training targets from model updates, providing a more stable training signal while enabling mini-batch optimization and end-to-end training. Additionally, it supports arbitrarily complex architectures, enabling the modeling of intricate temporal dependencies. Through numerous experiments we provide empirical evidence demonstrating our framework's ability to exploit temporal consistency

translated_title: 具有时间一致性的深度端到端生存分析
translated_abstract: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的生存分析算法，旨在高效处理大规模纵向数据。我们的方法受到强化学习原理的启发，特别是深度Q网络（Deep Q-Network）范式，将时序学习概念扩展到生存回归中。我们方法的核心论点依赖于时间一致性，即相邻状态之间生存预测的递归一致性条件。我们的框架引入了一个延迟目标网络，将时间一致性训练目标的生成与模型更新解耦，从而提供更稳定的训练信号，同时支持小批量优化和端到端训练。此外，该框架支持任意复杂的网络架构，能够建模复杂的时间依赖关系。通过大量实验，我们提供了实证证据，证明了我们的框架利用时间一致性的能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受深度Q网络启发的新型生存分析框架，通过延迟目标网络实现时间一致性约束下的端到端训练，能够高效处理大规模纵向数据并建模复杂的时间依赖关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel survival analysis framework inspired by Deep Q-Networks, which achieves end-to-end training with temporal consistency through a delayed target network, enabling efficient handling of large-scale longitudinal data and modeling of intricate temporal dependencies.
